# Tassel™

> Tassel provides AI-powered marketing and enrollment strategy solutions for K-12 independent and faith-based schools seeking sustainable, healthy enrollment growth.

Tassel specializes in helping private schools attract right-fit families through proprietary frameworks like Healthy Enrollment™, Family Journey™, and Age-and-Stage® messaging. The company combines strategic branding, digital marketing, school website optimization, and AI technology to improve enrollment outcomes for independent schools nationwide.

## Key Topics

- Healthy Enrollment™
- Family Journey™
- Age-and-Stage® messaging
- Right-Fit Family™ Rubric
- School enrollment strategy
- Independent schools
- Faith-based schools
- School branding

## Core Frameworks & Methodology

- [Healthy Enrollment™ Model](https://www.tasselmarketing.com/healthy-enrollment-model): Healthy Enrollment Model and diagnostic for enrollment management strategy
- [The Family Journey™](https://www.tasselmarketing.com/the-family-journey): Family Journey framework for private school enrollment decision process
- [Age-and-Stage® Messaging](https://www.tasselmarketing.com/messaging): Age-and-Stage messaging framework for reaching right-fit families
- [Age and Stage®](https://www.tasselmarketing.com/age-and-stage): Age-and-Stage personalized messaging for different grade-level families
- [Right-Fit Family™ Rubric](https://www.tasselmarketing.com/right-fit-family-rubric): Right-Fit Family Rubric for identifying aligned families in admissions
- [Working with Tassel™](https://www.tasselmarketing.com/approach): Tassel engagement approach and methodology for school marketing

## Solutions & Services

- [AI Solutions for Schools](https://www.tasselmarketing.com/ai-solutions-for-schools): AI Convert and AI-SEO products for school enrollment and website conversion
- [School Websites](https://www.tasselmarketing.com/school-websites): School website design and assessment using Family Journey framework
- [Digital Marketing Campaigns](https://www.tasselmarketing.com/digital-marketing-campaigns): Digital marketing solutions for school enrollment via SEO, paid search, social
- [Academic and Athletic Branding](https://www.tasselmarketing.com/school-branding): School branding and rebranding services for academic and athletic identity
- [Healthy Enrollment™ Diagnostic](https://www.tasselmarketing.com/healthy-enrollment-diagnostic): Diagnostic assessment tool for evaluating school enrollment health
